name: Yamikko Troublemaker
original_name: 病みっ子トラブルメーカー
source:
The protagonist, known as “Doctor”, decides his actions based on the choices made by “you”, the player.

Doctor, a psychiatrist, wakes up in a hospital.

For the next five days—until the patients are discharged—Doctor must take care of them.

However, the three patients are exceptionally sweet, exceptionally cute, and exceptionally troublesome troublemakers…?

A psychological horror, choice-based depression game where the protagonist’s fate changes depending on the choices made by you, the player.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3356700/YAMIKKO_TROUBLEMAKER/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
主角被称为“医生”，根据玩家“你”的选择来决定他的行动。

医生，一名精神科医生，在医院醒来。

在接下来的五天里——直到病人出院——医生必须照顾他们。

然而，三个病人却异常甜蜜、异常可爱、异常麻烦……？

一款心理恐怖、基于选择的抑郁游戏，主角的命运根据你（玩家）所做的选择而改变。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3356700/YAMIKKO_TROUBLEMAKER/]Steam[/url]]
